meta.title: Femio
meta.description: One account for a woman's whole health life.

home.title: Scaffold online.
home.body: Next.js 15 + TypeScript + Tailwind, wired to the Femio design tokens. Internationalization (EN/AR/FR/ES, RTL), UI components, and the PWA shell land next.

gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.subtitle: Femio design system — tokens, both themes, RTL-native.

feedback.info: Predictions show a range, never a single certain date.
feedback.warning: Your cycle looks irregular — this is expected in some phases.
feedback.redFlagBody: If symptoms feel severe, contact your clinician or local emergency services.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not load this just now.

calculators.title: Calculators
calculators.subtitle: Free tools for cycle, fertility, and pregnancy planning. No account needed.
calculators.disclaimer: These calculators give general estimates for learning and planning, not medical advice. Talk to your clinician about your health.

common.estimateNote: This is an estimate based on the dates you entered — every body is different.
common.lmpLabel: First day of your last period

dueDate.name: Due date
dueDate.desc: Estimate your due date from your last period.

ovulation.name: Fertile window
ovulation.desc: See your estimated fertile days and ovulation.

gestationalAge.name: Gestational age
gestationalAge.desc: See how many weeks along you are.

cycleLength.name: Cycle length
cycleLength.desc: Your average cycle length and variability.

dueDate.title: Due date estimator
dueDate.intro: Estimate your due date from the first day of your last period.

ovulation.title: Fertile window estimator
ovulation.intro: Estimate your fertile days from your last period and cycle length.
ovulation.awarenessNote: These dates support conception planning and awareness. They're estimates, not a reliable way to avoid pregnancy — talk to your clinician about your options.

gestationalAge.title: Gestational age
gestationalAge.intro: See how many weeks along you are, counting from your last period.

bmi.title: BMI calculator
bmi.intro: A general estimate of body mass from height and weight.
bmi.note: BMI is a general screen with limits — it doesn't reflect muscle, build, or body composition. Discuss what's healthy for you with your clinician.

cycleLength.title: Cycle length
cycleLength.intro: Enter a few period start dates to see your average cycle length.
cycleLength.irregular: Your cycles vary — that's common, and Femio adapts predictions when they do.
cycleLength.needTwo: Add at least two period start dates.

mode.heading: Where are you in your health journey?
mode.subheading: You can change this anytime — nothing here is locked.

pregnancy.name: I'm pregnant
pregnancy.desc: Week-by-week and what to watch for.

privacy.heading: Your privacy comes first
privacy.intro: Femio works without an account. Your health data is yours — never sold, never shared with advertisers.

anonymous.name: Start privately
anonymous.desc: No email, no account. You can add one later without losing anything.

account.name: Create an account
account.desc: Sync across devices with an email. Same privacy.

privacy.consentCore: Store my health entries so I can track them (required to use Femio).
privacy.consentInsights: Use my entries to show me patterns and insights.
privacy.consentResearch: Use my anonymized data to improve women's health research.
privacy.consentNote: You can change these anytime in Settings.

calendar.heading: Calendar
calendar.awarenessNote: Fertile-window dates support conception planning and awareness only — they're estimates, not a reliable way to avoid pregnancy.

track.title: Your cycle
track.savedOffline: Saved offline — it'll sync when you're back online.

prediction.heading: Next period
prediction.confidenceMedium: Based on {count} cycles — this will sharpen with more.
prediction.confidenceLow: Early estimate — keep logging to improve it.
prediction.irregularNote: Your cycles vary, so this is a wider window — that's expected, and there's no “late” count.
prediction.needMore: Log at least two periods to see a prediction.

symptoms.heading: How do you feel today?
symptoms.savedOffline: Saved offline — it'll sync when you're back online.

dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.cycleDayUnknown: Log a period to see your cycle day.
dashboard.irregularNote: Your cycles vary, so predictions stay a wider range — that's expected.
dashboard.needData: Log a couple of periods to unlock insights.
dashboard.modeSoon: Fuller {mode} tracking is coming soon. Your cycle tools are here in the meantime.

visitSummary.title: Doctor-visit summary
visitSummary.conditionsNote: Self-reported for tracking only — not a medical assessment.
visitSummary.disclaimer: This is a personal tracking summary you chose to share — not a medical record or clinical advice. Estimates are based on the data you logged.

admin.title: Translations
admin.desc: Review and approve UI strings per locale. English is the master; approving a string publishes it.

signIn.useMagicLink: Sign in with an email link instead
signIn.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
signIn.resetSentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a link to reset your password.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: We’ll email you a secure link to sign in — no password needed.
signIn.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
signIn.error: That link didn’t work or expired. Enter your email to get a new one.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a password for your account.
resetPassword.expiredBody: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from the sign-in page.

password.heading: Password
password.desc: Set or change a password so you can sign in without an email link.

summary.heading: Doctor-visit summary
summary.desc: A printable snapshot of your cycle, symptoms and notes to share with a clinician.

export.heading: Export your data
export.desc: Download everything Femio has stored for you as a file.

delete.heading: Delete your account
delete.desc: Permanently delete your account and all your data. This can't be undone.
delete.confirm: This permanently deletes your account and all your data. This can't be undone.
